THIS IS A WIP, ONLY ABOUT HALF OF THE ONESHOT COMIC IS DONE, SEE IT AS A PREVIEW FOR THE UPCOMING COMPLETE COMIC!

The crossover story that had to be done: the town of Guldove from Chrono Cross, built upon stilted platforms offshore in the El Nino Archipelago, is being paid a visit by the massive sailing wooden japanese-inspired city of Suikoden V!

Steena, the wise ruler of Guldove, successor to the previous sage woman who died of elderly age, finish reading a letter received days earlier, the letter signed by Saileed, Queen Arshtat's sister and second in line for the throne of the Falena Queendom - and Steena cannot contain her own excitement for the upcoming arrival of Saileed in Guldove, which is going to be celebrated with the most memorable summernight party ever!

Characters:

Arshtat - Queen of Falena (Suikoden V)
Saileeed - Arshtat's sister (Suikoden V)
Kisara - Raftfleet's helm woman with canonically MASSIVE TITS (Suikoden V)
Lin - Kisara's own daughter, very cute but flat chested (Suikoden V)
Steena - Guldove's ruler and overseer (Chrono Cross)
